anchors.name: Engels Verf
anchors.description: The rainbow fascia repeats across addresses 93–97: one paint shop joined to two BAG building records.
anchors.evidence: Address range 93–97: Engels own contact page. Rainbow stripes, white lettering, dark doors and pale display-window frames: own frontage photograph and June 2025 municipal panorama. Letterform and dimensions are simplified. Abstract shelves and paint tins are illustrative.

anchors.name: WALDO · 2025 frontage
anchors.description: A brown-and-cream pastry-shop front immediately beside Engels.
anchors.evidence: WALDO lettering and pale display surround visible in June 2025. Current occupancy unverified; external listings conflict. No awning added.

anchors.name: Koffiespot
anchors.description: Tall grey-green café glazing and a small white sign.
anchors.evidence: Ground-floor colour and broad glazing are observed in the linked municipal panorama. Dimensions, glazing divisions and colour values are authored approximations. This depicts the dated reference, not certified current occupancy.

anchors.name: Baskèts · 2025 frontage
anchors.description: A very dark shop base below a brown-brick house; the pale display frame makes the ground floor legible.
anchors.evidence: Ground-floor colour and broad glazing are observed in the linked municipal panorama. Dimensions, glazing divisions and colour values are authored approximations. This depicts the dated reference, not certified current occupancy.

anchors.name: Vlaamsch Broodhuys
anchors.description: Pale bakery frontage under a dark projecting awning.
anchors.evidence: Address: own location page. Pale ground floor and dark awning: June 2025 street reference. Furniture omitted; awning projection is approximate.

anchors.name: Siem van der Gragt
anchors.description: Paired green awnings and a dark fascia distinguish the butcher frontage.
anchors.evidence: Business association identifies 116a. Green awnings and the ecological-butcher fascia are visible in June 2025. Approximate span within the larger building; not a surveyed shop boundary.

anchors.name: Taupe corner awning
anchors.description: A deep taupe awning at the western street mouth, with a pale-framed ground floor.
anchors.evidence: Awning colour and location observed in June 2025; tenant left unnamed. BAG address identifies the corner building. Projected depth and glazing layout are approximate.

anchors.name: Blue awning · Elandsgracht 64
anchors.description: A blue canopy adds a distinct break in the northern shopfront row.
anchors.evidence: Blue awning and pale lower facade observed in June 2025. Business name withheld: frontage colour is useful without claiming a current tenant.

anchors.name: Dark awning · Elandsgracht 66
anchors.description: The neighbouring dark awning gives the row a second canopy depth and colour.
anchors.evidence: Ground-floor colour and broad glazing are observed in the linked municipal panorama. Dimensions, glazing divisions and colour values are authored approximations. This depicts the dated reference, not certified current occupancy.
